headline: ZOZO and Marui disclosed major exposures tied to PLAID’s KARTE platform, while Peach Aviation reported nearly 9 million records exposed in a separate vendor breach. Bitrise’s full incident report identified unauthorized file access in 15 customer workspaces.

incidents.what: ZOZO confirmed customer data exposure through KARTE. The ZOZOTOWN and WEAR counts may overlap; passwords and payment cards were not affected.
Marui Group confirmed that unauthorized access at marketing vendor PLAID exposed Marui retail and Epos Card data.
incidents.scale: 8.83M Marui records and 8.5M Epos records; not a unique-person count

incidents.what: Peach disclosed that an October intrusion at email vendor Yumirulink affected customer records. Passport and card information was not involved.
Reuters relayed CNN’s report of an investigation into apparent unauthorized access to the national crime database and said the FBI did not respond to its request for comment.
CISA confirmed that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver.
incidents.scale: Known exploited vulnerability; victim count not disclosed

incidents.what: Universeum told guests that an attack on booking supplier Visit Group International exposed contact information.
incidents.scale: About 280,000 contact records; no payment data reported exposed

incidents.what: Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Austria’s foreign ministry said intruders accessed its externally hosted website and viewed staff names and work contact details.
WOW WORLD confirmed that unauthorized access to service servers exposed information it held for four clients.
Wagyu’s operator attributed the incident to a hosting provider and promised reimbursements; the cause has not been independently verified.
incidents.scale: About $13.5M in earlier sales; no new loss reported

incidents.what: Bitrise said it restored services and linked its full report, which describes unauthorized file access in 15 customer workspaces.
DeFiChain gave a December remediation target and reported progress on Ocean and Light Wallet access.
